mainEntity.name: What is the process for starting an interior renovation project with your company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, needs, and budget. Next, we develop a detailed proposal including design concepts, material selections, and a comprehensive cost estimate. Once approved, we handle all necessary permits and commence work, managing every phase from demolition to final finishes. Throughout the project, we maintain open communication and conduct regular check-ins to ensure your satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our renovation process starts with a consultation, followed by a detailed proposal, permit acquisition, and then construction, with continuous communication throughout.
